title: Increasing-weight union-closed laws admit uniform lifts with the same abundance constant

scoped_dependencies.relation: Related join-closure setting; the new product-likelihood uniformization theorem is not a premise of N503 and does not transfer its quantitative reachability bounds.
The exact entropy-stagnation criterion in the supplied report is already retained in N504/LA224; N697 adds the uniformization and weighted/unweighted abundance equivalence, without modifying N504.
N697 gives a weighted/unweighted reformulation of the universal abundance question; it does not prove the separate candidate inequalities or close N563’s gate.
